scope: offline deterministic rules model; no human playtest or production changes

metric_definition.win_rate: percent; kills plus below-20-percent retreats reported separately
metric_definition.avg_rounds: successful runs only; null if no success
metric_definition.avg_remaining_hp: successful runs only; mean across original seats, downed seat counts as zero
metric_definition.random: uniform independent legal actions per living actor; not a model of new players
metric_definition.heuristic: solo_reasonable threshold20 and duo_cover fixture policies; one deterministic run each
metric_definition.retreat: only at round16, surviving party and boss/max strictly <20%; counted as success in model only
metric_definition.tie_break: fewest parameters changed from current; then stable Cartesian order
